WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
), above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event,
           ea.average_amount,
           ea.average_amount - oa.average_amount AS above_overall_gap
    FROM event_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE ea.average_amount > oa.average_amount
), with_above_average_mean AS (
    SELECT *,
           AVG(average_amount) OVER () AS mean_above_average_amount
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       average_amount,
       above_overall_gap,
       average_amount - mean_above_average_amount AS gap_from_above_average_mean
FROM with_above_average_mean
ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;
